front: What is the formula for Call Intrinsic Value?
back: Intrinsic Value (Call) = max(Spot Price - Strike Price, 0). OTM and ATM calls have zero intrinsic value.

front: What is the formula for Put Intrinsic Value?
back: Intrinsic Value (Put) = max(Strike Price - Spot Price, 0). OTM and ATM puts have zero intrinsic value.

front: How is an Option Premium decomposed?
back: Option Premium = Intrinsic Value + Time Value. Time Value reflects extrinsic opportunity and decays to zero at expiration.

front: What is the Break-Even price formula for Call positions (Long Call and Short Call)?
back: Break-Even Price = Strike Price + Premium (K + P).

front: What is the Break-Even price formula for Put positions (Long Put and Short Put)?
back: Break-Even Price = Strike Price - Premium (K - P).

front: What is the primary visual difference between an Option payoff line and a Futures payoff line?
back: An Option payoff line has a distinct kinked elbow at the strike price with flat risk-capped bounds, whereas a Futures payoff line is strictly linear and symmetric.
